affinity.notes: The bright blue-white chain energy reads as an ice or lightning enchantment rather than neutral force.

anatomy.notes: The spectral torso, armored head, arms, and tapering lower body are clear, with chains reading as external weapons.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "mid-range hook controller" semantically communicates Orbit-Blade Boundary Hunter (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Wide looping chains visibly establish the attack radius and a control-oriented ranged threat.

finish.notes: Metal, ragged cloth, smoke, and spectral highlights have a cohesive subdued finish.

framing.notes: The narrow vertical crop captures the full apparition and looping chain paths without crowding.

identity.notes: Blind perception "chained wraith or spectral jailer" semantically identifies wraiths/wraith-wraith.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
